items.title: Solex Energy plans 5.2 GW solar cell, 5 GWh BESS capacity by FY29
items.summary: The Indian solar module manufacturer and EPC company plans to establish 2.2 GW of solar cell manufacturing capacity by FY28 and scale it to 5.2 GW by early FY29. It also plans to establish its first 5 GWh phase of battery energy storage system capacity by FY29.

items.title: EIL bags over $450 million order from Dangote Group for Kenya refinery project
items.summary: Once completed, the project will help strengthen fuel production in East Africa, reduce dependence on imports and bolster regional energy security, the company said.
